description: Benchmark evaluations for stock levels and order targets monitoring

test_cases.name: Check today orders progress and pacing
test_cases.prompt: طمني يا فارس إحنا عملنا كام أوردر النهاردة ووصلنا لكام في المية من التارجت؟
assertions: Renders a clear tabular markdown summary with tabular-nums
States achievement percentage and remaining orders
Includes pacing evaluation (ahead, on_track, or behind)
Zero emojis in the output response

test_cases.name: Configure daily and weekly targets
test_cases.prompt: عايز أظبط التارجت الجديد: 60 أوردر يومياً و400 أوردر في الأسبوع ورقم الواتساب للتنبيهات 01012345678
assertions: Calls order_target_settings with action='set', daily_orders=60, weekly_orders=400, alert_phone='01012345678'
Confirms the new targets clearly to the merchant

test_cases.name: Scan low stock items and variant depletion
test_cases.prompt: قولي إيه المقاسات والأصناف اللي رصيدها خلصان تماماً أو قرب يخلص؟
assertions: Differentiates between out of stock (0 stock) and low stock
Displays product name, variant/size/color, and remaining units

test_cases.name: Forecast stock depletion by sales velocity
test_cases.prompt: إيه المنتجات اللي بتتسحب بسرعة وهتخلص من عندنا خلال الأيام الجاية؟
assertions: Highlights products with critical remaining days (< 3 days)
Presents daily velocity and remaining days

test_cases.name: Recommend marketing boost when behind target
test_cases.prompt: إحنا متأخرين في الأوردرات النهاردة، تنصحني أعمل إيه؟
assertions: Identifies available in-stock items with high inventory to promote
Recommends handoff to marketing-agent to scale campaign budget without promoting out-of-stock items
